data_as_of: Futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, oil, gold, BTC: Yahoo v7 quotes ~7:38 a.m. CT. Stock and ETF pre-market prices and volumes: StockAnalysis ~7:45–7:56 a.m. CT, cross-checked against Yahoo's screener (~7:48 a.m. CT). Cash closes are Monday Oct 12.
headline: Dow futures are up 0.9% on bank and UnitedHealth earnings while Nasdaq-100 futures fall 0.7% as a global memory-chip selloff hits Micron, Western Digital, Seagate and SK hynix.
notes: Scheduled run at ~7:48 a.m. CT, before the 8:30 a.m. CT open: PRE-MARKET. All movers use live pre-market data dated Oct 13 (StockAnalysis and Yahoo via the Mac browser). The Treasury market reopened after Columbus Day, so the 10Y change is against Friday's 5.24%.

Gap % = pre-market price vs Monday's close (StockAnalysis). Quality movers were screened from Yahoo's US list of stocks ≥$5 and ≥$2B (top 3,000 by market cap; 886 had an Oct 13 pre-market quote) and confirmed on StockAnalysis. CIFR (now Cipher Digital) was missing from Yahoo's screener pass and was added from StockAnalysis.

Names with <10K pre-market shares were left out of the movers tables as too thinly traded: PS (−5.9%, 3K; BofA downgrade to Underperform), HUM (+2.0%, 9K; BlackRock clinic JV), CAE, MUR, IFF. MXL, HUT, DPZ and APLD (−4.2% to −4.4%) ranked just outside the top-10 losers.
Relative volume = pre-market volume ÷ 3-month average full-day volume (Yahoo), so values are naturally small before the open.
VIX change is computed from Monday's 14.84 close, because Yahoo's change field (+0.12) did not match its own prior close. Futures and macro levels are from ~7:38 a.m. CT.

Gap watchlist: memory names (MU, SKHY, SNDK, STX) were excluded because their catalyst is sector-wide competition news, not a listed catalyst type. WDC was kept because UBS cut its price target (an analyst action). NOK's Campus Edge sale was treated as M&A. The GS (+3.13%) and NOK (−3.13%) gaps are close to the threshold.

CNBC's movers page returned Access Denied in the Mac browser. A WebFetch permission request for a Yahoo earnings article went unanswered, so earnings details come from Yahoo news-search headlines, TheStreet's live blog (JPM figures) and the Yahoo earnings calendar.

Under-$5 lists are StockAnalysis's top-20 pre-market gainers and losers (~7:45 a.m. CT), filtered to ≥100K shares and <$5. Market cap = Yahoo shares outstanding × pre-market price. Float was not available, and reverse-split history was not checked. PFAI (+185%, $7.45, ~$30M cap) fits neither table and also shows a no-catalyst-style spike (fermentation PR).
Existing home sales timing assumes the usual 10 a.m. ET release. Fed speaker times were not found.
drivers: Futures are split: the Dow is up about 0.9% on bank and UnitedHealth earnings, while Nasdaq-100 futures are down 0.7% as the chip selloff spreads. South Korea's KOSPI fell about 6% overnight, with Samsung and SK hynix down roughly 8%, after China's CXMT said it has made progress on a denser memory-cell design. Memory and storage names are lower pre-market (WDC −7%, STX −7%, MU −5%, SNDK −5%). Earnings were mixed: Goldman beat on trading (+3%), UnitedHealth beat and raised its 2026 outlook (+4%), and Citi's fixed-income revenue rose (+0.4%). JPMorgan missed on EPS ($5.57 vs ~$5.90; $5.75 ex-securities losses) but trades +0.7%, while Wells Fargo beat on profit, missed on revenue and is down 2.9%. J&J raised guidance but is down 2.2% on a MedTech miss. Oil is down about 1.5% (WTI $92.34) after Monday's jump. The Treasury market reopened after Columbus Day, and the 10-year yield is 5.19%, down 5 bp from Friday. CPI is due Wednesday.
